Definition: probably of Hebrew origin (apparently for H7509); Resa (i.e. Rephajah), an Israelite:--Rhesa.
BiblicalUsage: Resa stands in the genealogy of Jesus, the son of Zorobabel and the father of Joanna, in the line that runs from the exile to Joseph. The exile had scattered the royal line, and names like his are the thread that ties it back together.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that the genealogy keeps even the names we know nothing else about, because the line is the point.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
